judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the acceptance tests, `.lore/dod.md`, and updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, without actually implementing any of the production changes in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still only records `lastUsage`, the newly added acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/turn-usage.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when `npm test` is run. Additionally, the candidate completely missed updating the `afterModelResponse` signature in `OrchestratorHooks` and adding the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate also left the new behaviour inside the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section rather than moving it to the active specification section as the reference did.
